scenario_analysis.acceptance: accepted at T0+95 min: 158.630 at 15:05Z is about 43 pips above the 158.20 pre-release shelf (investingLive about 11:00Z, context) and above the 9 Nov D1 high 158.391; T0 and T0+30 min prices are not observed.

base_case.market_move: USDJPY holds above the 158.20 pre-release shelf and the broken 158.391 high and climbs through 158.770 toward higher levels before 13 Nov 08:00Z, as US front-end yields stay above flat-to-lower JGB yields.

scenario_analysis.confirmations: (1) BLS core CPI +0.3% m/m against 0.2% consensus; (2) the captured break of the 9 Nov D1 high 158.391 to 158.630 with every USD pair moving USD-up; (3) the JGB 2y down 16 bp over 4-6 Nov while US2Y held 4.51%.
scenario_analysis.driver: CLEAR. US front-end yields: USDJPY rose with every USD pair at the capture and on 6 Nov (+0.64% with EURUSD -0.79%); qualified by a 60-day US10Y correlation of 0.28.
scenario_analysis.invalidation_reason: below 158.04 the pair is back under the pre-release shelf and the 158.061 dossier capture, which means the CPI repricing failed for this pair.
scenario_analysis.invalidation_text: any trade below 158.04; the thesis is also broken by an M15 close below 158.20 while US500 is down more than 1% on the day, a Japanese official verbal warning, or the US 2y giving back most of its CPI-day rise.

main_alternative.market_move: a haven-yen bid on an equity selloff, or seven-week range supply at 158.77-159.04, sends USDJPY back below 158.04 toward the 9 Nov low 157.670.

scenario_analysis.mechanism: the hot October core CPI (+0.296% vs 0.2% consensus, BLS) reprices the US front end (2y +15-17 bp, context) while the JGB 2y had already fallen from 1.891% (4 Nov) to 1.732% (6 Nov) with US2Y at 4.51%; USDJPY's 20-day correlation to US10Y changes is +0.62 (beta 0.038 per point, US500 beta only 0.10), and yen speculators net long 27% of open interest must cover above 158.770.
scenario_analysis.opposite_mechanism: a haven-yen bid if the rates shock knocks equities (5 Nov: USDJPY -0.55% with US500 -4.86%) and range-top supply at 158.40-159.04; each predicts a return under 158.39 inside the horizon.
scenario_analysis.positioning: CFTC JPY speculators net long yen 102,321 of 380,641 (27%, COT 3 Nov) are forced to cover above 158.770; sellers have capped 158.40-159.04 on every D1 test since 24 Sep (highs 158.404, 159.037, 158.455, 158.512, 158.754, 158.952, 158.603, 158.605, 158.770, 158.669, 158.585; no D1 close above 158.84); official-action risk near 159.75-160.40, where the 1-2 Sep up-leg reversed. Crowd trade: long yen, wrong while USDJPY holds above 158.39.
scenario_analysis.priced: prior_pricing AMBIGUOUS; 5-day -0.65 ATR to the 9 Nov close (158.471 to 157.988), so nothing hawkish was priced before the print; the 158.630 capture sits +1.08 ATR over the 20-day mean 157.822, +1.43 over the 50-day 157.562 and -0.61 under the 200-day 159.086; 20-day range 156.075-158.770, 14 pips under its top; ATR percentile 30; the 48 h to 15 min drift and the implied move are not observed.
scenario_analysis.why_no_open: at the capture the price is 25-33 pips above the reviewed buying zone and 14 pips under the 158.770 range top, so buying there buys into seven-week range supply.
scenario_analysis.zone_reason: 158.30-158.38 retests the broken 9 Nov D1 high 158.391 from above, over the 158.20-158.24 pre-release shelf.
